## 本周报道 | This week’s report

**中文。** 本周报道介绍阿拉木图 Karagaily 萨卡时期墓丘中发现的金熊形饰物。官方公告认为它可能是头饰构件，并说明墓丘早已被盗扰，伴有人骨及陶片。墓地研究和后续分析仍在进行。

**English.** This week’s coverage describes a gold bear-shaped ornament from the Saka-period Karagaily mound in Almaty. The official announcement interprets it as a possible headdress attachment and notes ancient looting, human remains and pottery. Cemetery research and further analysis are continuing.

## 日期与既往工作 | Dates and earlier work

**中文。** 阿拉木图文化部门已于 2026-11-05 发布公告；抢救性发掘在 2026 年进行。本周是媒体报道，不是首次公布。

**English.** Almaty’s culture department issued its announcement on 2026-11-05; rescue excavation took place in 2026. This week’s media coverage is not the first announcement.

## 解释边界 | Limits of interpretation

**中文。** 饰物用途与埋葬人数仍属待验证解释；官方公告明确说确切人数尚未确定。本期不把推测人数或“欧亚唯一”写成既定事实。

**English.** Use of the ornament and the number of buried individuals remain interpretations to test; the announcement explicitly leaves the exact count unresolved. Neither an inferred count nor Eurasia-wide uniqueness is treated as established.
